purpose: Context KB for camt.055 CustomerPaymentCancellationRequest validation. For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and all possible fixes. Based on CBPR+ SR2025 Usage Guideline (camt.055.001.08) and SWIFT MX Enterprise KB.
reference_documents: SWIFT MX Enterprise LLM KB v2.0

iso_20022_rules.name: RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl
iso_20022_rules.description: If CopyDuplicate is present, then Related MUST be present. Related MUST contain the relevant BusinessApplicationHeader elements of the BusinessMessage to which this BusinessMessage relates.

iso_20022_rules.name: MessageOrGroupCaseRule
iso_20022_rules.description: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level (only one). Ensures uniqueness of the case across levels.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for uniqueness of case.

iso_20022_rules.name: MessageOrPaymentInformationCaseRule
iso_20022_rules.description: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level (only one).
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for uniqueness of case.

iso_20022_rules.name: MessageOrTransactionCaseRule
iso_20022_rules.description: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level (only one).
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for uniqueness of case.

iso_20022_rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
iso_20022_rules.description: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction; the SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline (message-level SupplementaryData is removed).

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupCancellationAndReasonRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is true, then OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/CancellationReasonInformation/Reason must be present.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for cancellation reason information in case of group cancellation.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupCancellationAndNumberOfTransactionsRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is false, then NumberOfTransactions must equal the number of occurrences of TransactionInformation.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for number of transactions.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupCancellationTrueAndPaymentInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is true, then OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group cancellation and payment information.

iso_20022_rules.name: GroupCancellationFalseAndPaymentInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is false, then OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation must be present.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group cancellation and payment information.

iso_20022_rules.name: PaymentInformationCancellationTrueAndTransactionInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/PaymentInformationCancellation is true, then TransactionInformation is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for group cancellation and transaction information.

iso_20022_rules.name: PaymentInformationCancellationFalseAndTransactionInformationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/PaymentInformationCancellation is false, then TransactionInformation must be present.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for negative group cancellation and transaction information.

iso_20022_rules.name: BICFI
iso_20022_rules.description: Valid BICs for financial institutions are registered and published by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority and consist of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDBICFIPattern
iso_20022_rules.description: XSD BICFIDec2014Identifier pattern (camt.055.001.12): [A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})? — applies to Assgnmt/Assgnr/Agt, Assgnmt/Assgne/Agt, AppHdr/Fr, AppHdr/To.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDDateTimeFormat
iso_20022_rules.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm (ISODateTime) and AppHdr/CreDt must use CBPR+ format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. No Z suffix, no milliseconds.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDv12Changes
iso_20022_rules.description: camt.055.001.12 (vs 001.08): Root element is CustomerPaymentCancellationRequestV12. Assgnmt/Assgnr and Assgnmt/Assgne accept Agt (agent) or Pty (party). CancellationReason3Choice uses ExternalCancellationReason1Code (4 chars) or Prtry (Max35Text). OrgnlClrSysRef added to TransactionInformation (new in v12). CtrlData element added at root level to carry NbOfTxs and CtrlSum.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_From_To_Assigner_Assignee_BIC_1_FormalRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/Fr BIC must match Assignment/Assigner/Agent BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match Assignment/Assignee/Agent BIC, except where AppHdr/CopyDuplicate = COPY or CODU.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_From_To_Assigner_Assignee_BIC_2_FormalRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/Fr BIC must match Assignment/Assigner/Agent BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match Assignment/Assignee/Agent BIC when AppHdr/CopyDuplicate is absent.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Assigner/Assignee BICFI
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Assigner and Assignee must be identified with a BICFI (via Agent/FinInstnId/BICFI); other elements are optional. The Assigner is the sender; the Assignee is the receiver.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Single Cancellation Request
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: The camt.055 must contain one Cancellation Request only. Underlying (Undrlyg) max occurrence reduced to 1 and OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/TransactionInformation reduced to a single occurrence (R[1..1]).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Transaction Case Mandatory
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Underlying/OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/TransactionInformation/Case is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). Note: message-level Case building block is removed, so the Case is carried at transaction level (consistent with the Case-uniqueness rules R4/R5/R6).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Original EndToEnd Mandatory
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Underlying/OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation/TransactionInformation/OriginalEndToEndIdentification is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Cancellation Reason Mandatory
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: TransactionInformation/CancellationReasonInformation/Reason is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). CancellationReasonInformation is reduced to a single occurrence (R[1..1]).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Originator_Presence_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: CancellationReasonInformation/Originator is populated only if different from the Case Creator.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_Identification_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: For agents: if BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, then Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed (ClrSysMmbId and LEI may complement); BICFI takes precedence on conflict. If BICFI is absent, (Nm & PstlAdr) OR [(Nm & PstlAdr) and ClrSysMmbId] must be present; exception: when Debtor Agent, Creditor Agent and all agents in between are within the same country, the clearing code only may be used.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_PointToPointOnSWIFT
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: If the transaction is exchanged on the SWIFT network (instructing agent/sender and instructed agent/receiver are on SWIFT), then BICFI is mandatory and other elements (e.g. LEI) are optional.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Business_Service_Usage_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' (SR2025). This element is mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). Datatype changed to UsageIdentifierPatternText.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Business_Message_Identifier_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must contain the Message Identification of the underlying message where available; otherwise the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Message_Definition_Identifier_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance, i.e. 'camt.055.001.08'.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_CharacterSet_Usage_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: All proprietary/text fields (excl. Nm/Adr for all actors and RmtInf) limited to FIN-X charset. Nm/Adr/RmtInf and proxy email extended with !#$%&*=^_`{|}~";<>@[\] (< as <, > as >).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_DateTime_Format
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses CBPR_DateTime: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM with a mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset; Z suffix forbidden. NOTE: Assignment/CreationDateTime uses ISODateTime under CGI-MP_ISODateTime_TextualRule (local time with UTC offset preferred; UTC 'Z' format permitted; 3 decimal fraction digits) — the Z restriction does NOT apply to Assgnmt/CreDtTm.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: BrnchId Removed
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: BranchIdentification is removed from agent FinInstnId blocks (AppHdr Fr/To agents, Related Fr/To agents, Assigner/Assignee agents and transaction agents) under CBPR+ SR2025.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Removed Building Blocks/Elements
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Removed under CBPR+ SR2025 include: AppHdr/BizPrcgDt, AppHdr/Sgntr, the message-level Case building block, the ControlData building block, and message-level SupplementaryData.

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02 defined as mandatory).

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt, and optionally CharSet/MktPrctc/CpyDplct/PssblDplct/Prty/Rltd.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint (the assigner/sender). When exchanged on SWIFT, must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 (FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI). Must match Assignment/Assigner/Agent BIC. If inconsistent, BIC takes precedence.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{assigner_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from Assignment/Assigner/Agent/FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr BICFI does not match Assignment/Assigner/Agent BICFI (when CpyDplct is absent or not COPY/CODU).
possible_fixes: Read Assigner/Agent/FinInstnId/BICFI and set AppHdr/Fr/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI to the same value.
Alternatively update Assigner Agent BICFI to match AppHdr/Fr if Fr is authoritative.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters following ISO 9362.
Example valid BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint (the assignee/receiver). When exchanged on SWIFT, must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 (FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI). Must match Assignment/Assignee/Agent BIC. If inconsistent, BIC takes precedence.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{assignee_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from Assignment/Assignee/Agent/FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AppHdr/To BICFI does not match Assignment/Assignee/Agent BICFI (when CpyDplct is absent or not COPY/CODU).
possible_fixes: Read Assignee/Agent/FinInstnId/BICFI and set AppHdr/To/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI to match.
Alternatively update Assignee Agent BICFI to match AppHdr/To if To is authoritative.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message, as defined by the sending application or system.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert a unique <BizMsgIdr>{Max35Text}</BizMsgIdr> (e.g. CXL-YYYYMMDD-001).

errors.description: BizMsgIdr exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the value to a maximum of 35 characters.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must exactly match the Document namespace.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>camt.055.001.08</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute from the Document root element (e.g. urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.055.001.08).
Set MsgDefIdr to 'camt.055.001.08'. Ensure no trailing spaces or version mismatches.

tags.note: Minimum occurrence changed to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 guideline. Datatype changed to UsageIdentifierPatternText.
tags.description: Business Service identifier. Mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025; must be 'swift.cbprplus.03'.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.03</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: BizSvc contains an incorrect value (e.g. 'swift.cbprplus.02' from older release).
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.03' as mandated by SR2025.
Note: SR2024 and earlier used 'swift.cbprplus.02'; upgrade to .03 for SR2025.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format with a mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset; Z suffix forbidden by the CBPR_DateTime pattern.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under the CBPR_DateTime pattern (a +/-HH:MM offset is mandatory).
AppHdr/CreDt lacks the mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset.

tags.description: Priority of the Business Message. Datatype changed to Priority2Code (NORM, HIGH).

errors.description: AppHdr/Prty contains a value not in the allowed code list (Priority2Code).
possible_fixes: Replace with 'NORM' (normal) or 'HIGH' (high priority).
Default to 'NORM' if priority is not specifically determined.

tags.description: Business Processing Date. Removed under CBPR+; must not be present.

errors.description: AppHdr/BizPrcgDt is present; this element is removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BizPrcgDt element from AppHdr entirely.

tags.note: Removed by CBPR+ SR2025 guideline. This information is available at the level of the SWIFTNet Header.
tags.description: Digital signature of the Business Entity. Removed under CBPR+; must not be present.

errors.description: AppHdr/Sgntr is present; this element is removed under CBPR+ SR2025 (signature handled at SWIFTNet Header level).
possible_fixes: Remove the Sgntr element from AppHdr entirely.

tags.description: Indicates whether the message is a Copy, a Duplicate or a copy of a duplicate. When COPY or CODU, the From/To-to-Assigner/Assignee BIC matching rule is relaxed. If present, Related (Rltd) must be present (R1).

errors.description: CpyDplct is present but Rltd is absent; violates R1 (RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl).
possible_fixes: Add a <Rltd> block carrying the BAH elements of the related (original) message.
Remove CpyDplct if the message is not a copy/duplicate.

tags.note: Maximum occurrence reduced to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 (base [0..*]).
tags.description: Related Business Application Header(s). If used, must transport the exact same information as in the BAH of the related message. Must be present when CpyDplct is present (R1).

errors.description: CpyDplct is present but Rltd is absent; violates R1.
possible_fixes: Insert a <Rltd> block carrying the BAH elements of the related (original) message.
Alternatively remove CpyDplct if the message is not a copy/duplicate.

errors.description: More than one Rltd occurrence present; CBPR+ SR2025 reduced maximum occurrence to 1.
possible_fixes: Keep only a single Rltd block; remove additional occurrences.

tags.description: Assignment block. Identifies the assignment of the investigation/cancellation case from an assigner to an assignee. Contains Id [1..1], Assgnr [1..1], Assgne [1..1], CreDtTm [1..1].

errors.description: Assgnmt block is absent; it is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert a <Assgnmt> block with Id, Assgnr, Assgne and CreDtTm.

tags.description: Uniquely identifies the case assignment.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Id is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Id>{unique assignment identification, max 35 chars}</Id>.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Id exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 35 characters.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Id contains characters outside the FIN-X character set.

tags.note: Party40Choice__1: Pty or Agt (mutually exclusive). The assigner is the sender of the message and must be identified with a BICFI (via Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI). Must match AppHdr/Fr.
tags.description: Party who assigns the case (the sender). Identified by Agent BICFI for SWIFT exchange.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Assgnr is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Assgnr><Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{assigner_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt></Assgnr>.
Use the same BIC as AppHdr/Fr.

errors.description: Assgnr/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI is absent; Assigner must be identified with a BICFI.
possible_fixes: Add <BICFI>{assigner_BICFI}</BICFI> to the Assigner Agent FinInstnId.
Harvest the BIC from AppHdr/Fr.

errors.description: Assgnr/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

tags.note: Party40Choice__1: Pty or Agt (mutually exclusive). The assignee is the receiver of the message and must be identified with a BICFI (via Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI). Must match AppHdr/To.
tags.description: Party to which the case is assigned (the receiver). Identified by Agent BICFI for SWIFT exchange.

errors.description: Assgnmt/Assgne is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Assgne><Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{assignee_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt></Assgne>.
Use the same BIC as AppHdr/To.

errors.description: Assgne/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI is absent; Assignee must be identified with a BICFI.
possible_fixes: Add <BICFI>{assignee_BICFI}</BICFI> to the Assignee Agent FinInstnId.
Harvest the BIC from AppHdr/To.

errors.description: Assgne/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

tags.note: Uses ISODateTime under CGI-MP_ISODateTime_TextualRule (NOT the strict CBPR_DateTime). Preferred representation is local time with UTC offset (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sss+/-hh:mm); UTC 'Z' format is permitted; decimal fractions of seconds with 3 digits.
tags.description: Date and time at which the assignment was created.

errors.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime, e.g. YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ}</CreDtTm>.

errors.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm is not a valid ISODateTime.
possible_fixes: Use ISODateTime: local time with UTC offset (preferred) or UTC with 'Z'; up to 3 fractional-second digits.
Note: unlike AppHdr/CreDt, the 'Z' suffix is permitted here (CGI-MP rule).

tags.note: Removed by CBPR+ SR2025 guideline (message-level Case building block). The case is carried at transaction level (TxInf/Case, which is made mandatory).
tags.description: Message-level investigation Case. Removed under CBPR+; must not be present at message level.

errors.description: Message-level Case block is present; it is removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the message-level Case block.
Carry the Case at transaction level: Undrlyg/OrgnlPmtInfAndCxl/TxInf/Case (mandatory).

errors.description: Case is present at more than one level; Case may appear at only one of Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation (R4/R5/R6).
possible_fixes: Keep Case at exactly one level (transaction level under CBPR+); remove it from the others.

tags.description: ControlData (NbOfTxs, CtrlSum) at message level. Removed under CBPR+; must not be present.

errors.description: CtrlData block is present; it is removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the CtrlData block entirely.

tags.note: Maximum occurrence reduced to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 (base [1..*]). The camt.055 must contain one Cancellation Request only.
tags.description: Underlying transaction block. Identifies the payment instruction(s) to be cancelled. Contains OrgnlGrpInfAndCxl [0..1] and OrgnlPmtInfAndCxl [0..1] (R[1..1]). Group-cancellation rules R10-R13 apply.

errors.description: Undrlyg block is absent; at least one (single) Underlying is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert a <Undrlyg> block containing OrgnlGrpInfAndCxl and/or OrgnlPmtInfAndCxl as required.

errors.description: More than one Undrlyg block present; CBPR+ SR2025 reduced maximum occurrence to 1 (one cancellation request only).
possible_fixes: Keep a single Undrlyg block; split additional cancellation requests into separate camt.055 messages.

tags.note: OriginalGroupHeader15: GrpCxlId, Case, OrgnlMsgId [1..1], OrgnlMsgNmId [1..1], OrgnlCreDtTm, NbOfTxs, CtrlSum, GrpCxl, CxlRsnInf. Group-cancellation rules R10/R11/R12/R13 apply.
tags.description: Original group information and cancellation. Identifies the original message group and whether the whole group is being cancelled (GroupCancellation).

errors.description: GroupCancellation is true but CancellationReasonInformation/Reason is absent; violates R10.
possible_fixes: Add a CxlRsnInf/Rsn when GroupCancellation = true.

errors.description: GroupCancellation is false but NumberOfTransactions does not equal the number of TransactionInformation occurrences; violates R11.
possible_fixes: Set NbOfTxs to the actual count of TxInf occurrences (1 under CBPR+ single-transaction rule).

errors.description: GroupCancellation is true but OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation is present; violates R12.
possible_fixes: Remove OrgnlPmtInfAndCxl when GroupCancellation = true (whole group cancelled).

errors.description: GroupCancellation is false but OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation is absent; violates R13.
possible_fixes: Provide OrgnlPmtInfAndCxl (with TransactionInformation) when GroupCancellation = false.

tags.description: Original Message Identification of the message containing the transaction(s) being cancelled.

errors.description: OrgnlGrpInfAndCxl/OrgnlMsgId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlMsgId>{original message identification}</OrgnlMsgId>.
Harvest from the GrpHdr/MsgId of the original payment message.

errors.description: OrgnlMsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 35 characters.

tags.description: Original Message Name Identification, e.g. pain.001.001.xx, pacs.008.001.08.

errors.description: OrgnlGrpInfAndCxl/OrgnlMsgNmId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlMsgNmId>{original message name identification, e.g. pain.001.001.09 or pacs.008.001.08}</OrgnlMsgNmId>.

tags.note: Reduced to a single occurrence (R[1..1]). OriginalPaymentInstruction34__1: PmtCxlId, Case, OrgnlPmtInfId [1..1], OrgnlGrpInf, NbOfTxs, CtrlSum, PmtInfCxl, CxlRsnInf, TxInf [R1..1]. Rules R16/R17 apply.
tags.description: Original payment information and cancellation. Identifies the original payment instruction and the transaction(s) to cancel.

errors.description: PaymentInformationCancellation is true but TransactionInformation is present; violates R16.
possible_fixes: Remove TxInf when PaymentInformationCancellation = true (whole payment information cancelled).

errors.description: PaymentInformationCancellation is false but TransactionInformation is absent; violates R17.
possible_fixes: Provide TxInf when PaymentInformationCancellation = false.

errors.description: OrgnlPmtInfAndCxl/OrgnlPmtInfId is absent (mandatory).
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlPmtInfId>{original payment information identification}</OrgnlPmtInfId>.

tags.note: Reduced to a single occurrence (R[1..1]) — one cancellation request only. PaymentTransaction109__1: CxlId, Case [made mandatory], OrgnlInstrId, OrgnlEndToEndId [made mandatory], OrgnlUETR, OrgnlInstdAmt, OrgnlReqdExctnDt, OrgnlReqdColltnDt, CxlRsnInf [R1..1], OrgnlTxRef, SplmtryData. Required when PmtInfCxl is false (R17).
tags.description: Transaction information — the original transaction being cancelled and the cancellation reason.

errors.description: TxInf/Case is absent; it is made mandatory (min 1) under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <Case><Id>{case id}</Id><Cretr>{case creator}</Cretr></Case> inside TxInf.
Ensure Case is present at only this one level (R4/R5/R6 uniqueness).

errors.description: TxInf/OrgnlEndToEndId is absent; it is made mandatory (min 1) under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlEndToEndId>{EndToEndId of the original transaction}</OrgnlEndToEndId>.
Harvest from the underlying payment's PmtId/EndToEndId.

errors.description: TxInf/OrgnlUETR is present but is not a valid lowercase UUID v4.
possible_fixes: Ensure OrgnlUETR is lowercase hex in format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (y in 8,9,a,b), 36 chars.
Harvest the UETR from the underlying pacs.008/pain.001 transaction.

tags.description: Amount of the original transaction. When present must be a valid xs:decimal with a mandatory Ccy attribute. The decimal separator is always a dot; no thousands separators, currency symbols, or trailing punctuation allowed.

errors.description: OrgnlInstdAmt text has a trailing decimal point (e.g. '307845.85.'). Not a valid xs:decimal; fails XSD validation.
possible_fixes: Strip the trailing dot: '307845.85.' → '307845.85'.
AI fix: remove trailing period and reformat to ISO 4217 decimal precision for the Ccy attribute (USD → 2 d.p., JPY → 0 d.p.).

errors.description: OrgnlInstdAmt decimal places do not match the ISO 4217 precision for the Ccy (e.g. '307845.850000' for USD, or '1000.50' for JPY).
possible_fixes: Reformat to correct decimal places for the Ccy (USD/EUR → 2, JPY → 0).
AI fix: look up ISO 4217 precision for the Ccy attribute and reformat in place.

errors.description: OrgnlInstdAmt text is not a valid decimal (e.g. contains currency symbol $, comma thousands separator, or non-numeric text).
possible_fixes: Remove currency symbols and thousands separators.
Use dot (not comma) as decimal separator.
AI fix: strip non-numeric decoration and reparse.
